Research purpose: Make material and interface claims setting-specific, duration-aware, and reproducible
Highest-value artifacts: Material evidence matrix; EvidenceManifest.v1; translation-gap map; duration/replication weighting
Main gap found: Bench, preclinical, clinical, and review claims need consistent separation and exact limitation records
Exit condition: Every material claim is linked to setting, endpoint, duration, source, replication status, and translation gap

Research purpose: Test whether adaptive decoding and minimized features improve defined assistive tasks while preserving control
Highest-value artifacts: Locked decoder protocol; drift taxonomy; calibration report; feature sufficiency record; Pareto frontier
Main gap found: No unified cross-object protocol tying drift, calibration burden, ECE, abstention, agency, and pre-registered index weights
Exit condition: Raw-vs-derived and fixed-vs-adaptive comparisons are preregistered, reproducible, and reported with uncertainty

Research purpose: Protect sensitive data and software supply chain through bounded leakage, agility, and reviewed lifecycle controls
Highest-value artifacts: Helper-data budget; cipher-suite registry; PUF/TVLA/FMEA records; key lifecycle policy; SBOM link
Main gap found: Crypto-agility schema exists but needs integrated implementation, anti-downgrade testing, and lifecycle evidence
Exit condition: No revoked suite is selectable; keys/suites are versioned; helper-data leakage is bounded; SBOMs remain current

Research purpose: Enforce minimum disclosure, consent, revocation, routing integrity, retention, and reviewable audit trails
Highest-value artifacts: Consent receipt; institutional reference; Rego authorization; telemetry audit chain; reroute receipt
Main gap found: Full append/sign/checkpoint audit-chain implementation and periodic checkpoint anchoring are missing
Exit condition: Every access is purpose-scoped, revocable, logged minimally, integrity-protected, and reviewable

Research purpose: Ensure AI assistance and node coordination preserve authorship, local refusal, override, and human oversight
Highest-value artifacts: Agency gate; abstention policy; federation contribution schema; topology hypothesis; longitudinal value records
Main gap found: Need a single acceptance suite proving hub non-coercion, accessible confirmation, stop behavior, and material-change review
Exit condition: No external action occurs without explicit approval; local consent cannot be overridden; user-defined value is measured longitudinally

Research purpose: Make the whole portfolio queryable, reproducible, and release-gated
Highest-value artifacts: Provenance graph; reproducibility chain; SBOM/vulnerability lifecycle; operational resource account; T3 validator
Main gap found: Rust implementations, graph reachability CI, schema locks, shared test vectors, and end-to-end integration tests are incomplete
Exit condition: Every public result traces Claim → Evidence → Data → Method → Result → Review → Governance → Supersession
